import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import warnings
import os
import re

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv", header=0)

# Verify label column name from sample_submission
submission_columns = sample_sub.columns.tolist()
label_col = "Insult" if "Insult" in submission_columns else list(submission_columns)[2]
print(f"Using label column: {label_col}")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


# Clean function - remove quotes and normalize text safely
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    # Remove outer double quotes and inner quotes
    text = re.sub(r'^["\']+', "", text)
    text = re.sub(r'["\']+$', "", text)
    # Remove single quotes too
    text = text.replace("'", "")
    # Replace newlines with space
    text = text.replace("\n", " ")
    text = text.replace("\r", "")
    # Replace multiple spaces with single space
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    # Convert back to string and ensure it's not empty
    text = str(text).strip()
    return text if text else ""


# Apply cleaning
train_df[f"{label_col}_cleaned"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(lambda x: clean_text(x))
test_df[f"{label_col}_cleaned"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(lambda x: clean_text(x))


# Enhanced feature extraction with EMOTIONAL INTENSITY FEATURES
def safe_extract_features(text_list):
    manual_features = []

    def process_single_text(text):
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            text = str(text)
        if not text.strip():
            return [0.0] * len(manual_features)

        words = text.split()
        if not words:
            return [0.0] * len(manual_features)

        feat = [0.0] * len(manual_features)

        # Length metrics
        len_words = float(len(words))
        len_chars = float(len(text))
        avg_word_len = len_chars / len_words if len_words > 0 else 0

        # Punctuation analysis - enhanced
        punct_seq_count = 0
        for i in range(len(text) - 1):
            if text[i].isalnum() == False and text[i + 1].isalnum() == False:
                punct_seq_count += 1
        punct_density = min(punct_seq_count / max(1, len_chars), 1.0) * 100

        # Case sensitivity
        upper_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
        lower_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.islower())
        all_caps = text.upper() == text if len(text) > 1 else False
        all_lower = text.lower() == text if len(text) > 1 else False
        cap_ratio = upper_count / max(1, len_chars)

        # Special chars
        special_char = sum(1 for c in text if not c.isalnum() and not c.isspace())
        special_ratio = special_char / max(1, len_chars)

        # Question/negation/rhetorical patterns
        question_marks = text.count("?")
        exclamation = text.count("!")
        rhetorical_score = question_marks * 2 + exclamation

        # Multi-word negations
        neg_patterns = ["not", "never", "dont", "willnt", "cant", "shouldnt", "wouldnt"]
        negation_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(n.lower() in w.lower() for n in neg_patterns)
        )

        # Profanity terms
        profanity_terms = [
            "damn",
            "shit",
            "fuck",
            "bitch",
            "ass",
            "idiot",
            "stupid",
            "faggot",
            "crap",
            "hell",
            "gay",
            "fucking",
            "lame",
            "suck",
            "loser",
            "dumb",
            "moron",
            "retard",
            "bastard",
            "whore",
            "nigga",
        ]
        prof_match = sum(1 for term in profanity_terms if term.lower() in text.lower())

        # Unicode anomalies
        non_ascii = sum(1 for c in text if ord(c) > 127)
        unicode_density = non_ascii / max(1, len_chars)

        # Emoji/pattern detection
        emoji_pattern = r"[^\x00-\x7F]{2,}"
        emoji_sequences = len(re.findall(emoji_pattern, text))
        special_emoji_ratio = emoji_sequences / max(1, len_chars)

        # Word length stats
        long_words = len([w for w in words if len(w) > 5])
        short_words = len([w for w in words if len(w) < 3])
        avg_word_len_std = (
            np.std([len(w) for w in words], ddof=1) if len(words) > 1 else 0
        )

        # Text density
        alpha_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isalpha()) / max(1, len_chars)

        # NEW: Emotional Intensity Features - CRITICAL IMPROVEMENT
        # Intensifier word counts
        intensifiers = [
            "very",
            "absolutely",
            "totally",
            "completely",
            "incredibly",
            "extremely",
            "highly",
            "so",
            "way",
            "super",
            "superb",
        ]
        intensifier_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if w.lower() in [i.lower() for i in intensifiers]
        )
        intensifier_ratio = intensifier_count / max(1, len_words)

        # Shouting patterns - ALL CAPS proportion
        shout_pattern = re.findall(r"[A-Z]{5,}", text)
        shouting_instances = len(shout_pattern)
        shouting_ratio = shouting_instances / max(1, len_chars)

        # Punctuation explosion (multiple exclamation marks together)
        exclaim_groups = re.findall(r"!\{1,9\}", text)
        multi_exclamation = len(exclaim_groups)

        # Uppercase word ratio (all caps words)
        upper_word_count = len([w for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) >= 2])
        upper_word_ratio = upper_word_count / max(1, len_words)

        # Return fixed-length array
        return np.array(
            [
                len_words,
                avg_word_len,
                punct_density,
                cap_ratio,
                special_ratio,
                question_marks,
                exclamation,
                rhetorical_score,
                negation_count,
                prof_match,
                non_ascii,
                unicode_density,
                special_emoji_ratio,
                long_words,
                short_words,
                alpha_ratio,
                avg_word_len_std,
                intensifier_ratio,  # NEW
                shouting_ratio,  # NEW
                multi_exclamation,  # NEW
                upper_word_ratio,  # NEW
            ],
            dtype=np.float32,
        )

    for text in text_list:
        feat = process_single_text(text)
        if feat is not None:
            manual_features.append(feat)
        else:
            manual_features.append(np.zeros(len(manual_features), dtype=np.float32))

    return np.array(manual_features, dtype=np.float32)


# Get labels
y_train = train_df[label_col].values.astype(np.int64)

# Process training data manually with enhanced features
X_train_manual = safe_extract_features(train_df[f"{label_col}_cleaned"].tolist())
print(f"Manual features shape: {X_train_manual.shape}")

# Word-level TF-IDF features using word boundaries
tfidf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.95,
    stop_words="english",
    lowercase=True,
    token_pattern=r"(?u)\b\w+\b",
)

tfidf_word_raw = tfidf_word.fit_transform(train_df[f"{label_col}_cleaned"].tolist())

# CHARACTER-LEVEL TF-IDF FEATURES WITH IMPROVED RANGE (1-5)
tfidf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(1, 5),
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.95,
    stop_words="english",
    lowercase=True,
    token_pattern=r"(?u)\b\w+\b|(?u)\b\W{2,}\b",
)

tfidf_char_raw = tfidf_char.fit_transform(train_df[f"{label_col}_cleaned"].tolist())

# Combine features: manual + word n-grams + char n-grams
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_manual, tfidf_word_raw, tfidf_char_raw])
print(f"Combined features shape: {X_train_combined.shape}")

# Split into train/val for validation (hold-out set NEVER touched during final training)
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined, y_train, test_size=0.3, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train model with balanced class weights and optimized RF parameters
rf_clf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=20,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    oob_score=False,
)
rf_clf.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

# Predict probabilities on held out validation set (NO retraining here!)
y_pred_proba = rf_clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_pred_proba)
print(f"AUC-ROC on validation set: {auc_val:.4f}")

# Process TEST DATA - use same feature extraction pipeline
test_cleaned = test_df[f"{label_col}_cleaned"].tolist()
X_test_manual = safe_extract_features(test_cleaned)
X_test_tfidf_word = tfidf_word.transform(test_cleaned)
X_test_tfidf_char = tfidf_char.transform(test_cleaned)
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_manual, X_test_tfidf_word, X_test_tfidf_char])

# Make predictions without scaling (since Random Forest doesn't need scaling)
test_probabilities = rf_clf.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

print(f"Test predictions length: {len(test_probabilities)}")
print(f"Sample predictions: {test_probabilities[:5]}")

# Create submission file with correct format using template
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test_df["Comment"].tolist(), label_col: test_probabilities}
)

# Write to required path
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"AUC-ROC score: {auc_val:.4f}")
